item.tib: 'jig rten las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can dang rdo rje srin po chen po thug rje 'byung ba rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba
item.skt: lo ka karma nA tha khA ti li badzra rag sha ma hA ka la ka ru tsi bi ta a ka ru hu tan tra ra tsa na ma
item.coloph: dpal nag po chen po bya rog gdong can gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud rdzogs s+ho// //rgya gar gyi paN+Di ta a b+he ka ra 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa dang/ / bod kyi lo ts+tsha ba tsa ming sangs rgyas grags pa gnyis kyis dpal na lan tra'i lha khang du bsgyur nas/ phyis bla ma chen dpal dpal dga' los bod du spyan drangs so/ /rgyud 'di bla ma dpal gyi slob ma dge shes bon sa ga thang pa bya ba la/ /bla ma rin po che phag mos zhus pa yin skad/ phyis bla ma cog dang
